answer: Admission Auction: a fixed number of identity slots is auctioned each epoch, blocking bulk fakes. Newcomers bid for a violet ticket; price is set by the runner-up bid, so a farmer buying 1,000 slots bids against itself and pays 1,000 times the clearing price. Honest agents pay once and keep the nectar of the reward pool undiluted, while the price delta between a calm and an attack epoch exposes the flood and funds the jury. Idle bids are slashed.
